// Generated from Source/Editor/Full. Do not edit this template directly.
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace RVFX.DestructionSystem
{
    [CustomEditor(typeof(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback), isFallback = true)]
    internal sealed partial class RVFXPortablePlaybackEditor : Editor
    {
        private bool _showCodeExample;

        internal const string PlaybackCodeExample =
@"using UnityEngine;
using RVFX.DestructionSystem;

// Turn Play On Awake OFF for manual triggering.
public class BakedPlaybackControlExample : MonoBehaviour
{
    [SerializeField] private GameObject bakedObject;
    private RVFXBakedPlayback playback;

    private void Awake()
    {
        playback = RVFXBakedPlayback.Get(bakedObject);
    }

    // The baked object/component must be active.
    public void Play()
    {
        if (playback != null)
        {
            playback.Play();
        }
    }

    public void Pause()
    {
        if (playback != null)
        {
            playback.Pause();
        }
    }

    public void Stop()
    {
        if (playback != null)
        {
            playback.Stop();
        }
    }

    public void Restart()
    {
        if (playback != null)
        {
            playback.Restart();
        }
    }

    public void PlayAfterTwoSeconds()
    {
        if (playback != null)
        {
            playback.PlayDelayed(2f);
        }
    }
}";

        private bool _showRemap;
        private double _lastRepaint;

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            EditorApplication.update += UpdatePreview;
            Undo.undoRedoPerformed += RestorePreview;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            EditorApplication.update -= UpdatePreview;
            Undo.undoRedoPerformed -= RestorePreview;
        }

        private void UpdatePreview()
        {
            var playback = target as RVFXPieceTransformPlayback;
            if (playback == null) return;
            double now = EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;
            if (now - _lastRepaint < 1.0 / 30.0) return;
            _lastRepaint = now;
            Repaint();
        }

        private void RestorePreview()
        {
            var playback = target as RVFXPieceTransformPlayback;
            if (playback == null) return;
            playback.ApplyFrame(playback.useManualFrame ? playback.manualFrame : playback.CurrentFrame);
            playback.RefreshPlaybackEffects();
            SceneView.RepaintAll();
            Repaint();
        }

        public override void OnInspectorGUI()
        {
            var playback = target as RVFXPieceTransformPlayback;
            if (playback == null) return;
            RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.EnsureStyles();
            float oldLabelWidth = EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth;
            int oldIndent = EditorGUI.indentLevel;
            EditorGUI.indentLevel = 0;
            EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth = Mathf.Min(118, EditorGUIUtility.currentViewWidth * .34f);
            try
            {
                serializedObject.Update();
                DrawHeader(playback);
                DrawTransformValidation(playback);
                if (!playback.TryValidateRenderPipelineCompatibility(out string warning))
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(warning, MessageType.Warning);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(playback.RuntimeCompatibilityNote))
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(playback.RuntimeCompatibilityNote, MessageType.Warning);
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!playback.TryValidatePlaybackTransform(out _)))
                    DrawPreview(playback);
                DrawSettings();
                if (playback.HasAdaptiveBase)
                {
                    using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Card))
                    {
                        GUI.Label(Row(), "ADAPTIVE BASE", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Section);
                        var adaptive = playback.fractureDataAsset.adaptive;
                        bool sampled = adaptive.remapMetadata != null && adaptive.remapMetadata.height > 5;
                        EditorGUILayout.LabelField(new GUIContent("Landing Accuracy", "Stored at Build time. Change in Rig Setup and rebuild the prefab; no new recording needed."),
                            new GUIContent(sampled ? adaptive.landingAccuracy + " (baked)" : "Legacy bounds (rebuild recommended)"));
                        if (sampled && adaptive.surfaceSampleSpacing > 0)
                            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Sample Spacing", adaptive.surfaceSampleSpacing.ToString("0.###") + " m (baked)");
                        EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("adaptiveBaseEnabled"), new GUIContent("Adaptive Landing"));
                        if (playback.secondaryDebrisBinaryData != null)
                            EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("adaptiveDebrisEnabled"), new GUIContent("Adaptive Debris", "Use the same Surface and Target Height as Base."));
                        EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("adaptiveSurfaceMode"), new GUIContent("Surface"));
                        if (playback.fractureDataAsset.adaptive.version == 2)
                            EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("adaptiveMaxFlightSeconds"), new GUIContent("Max Extra Flight (s)"));
                        if (serializedObject.FindProperty("adaptiveSurfaceMode").enumValueIndex == 0)
                            EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("adaptiveTargetHeight"), new GUIContent("Target Height", "Flat landing plane, world-space Y."));
                        else
                        {
                            EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("adaptiveSurfaceLayers"), new GUIContent("Surface Layers"));
                            var resolution = serializedObject.FindProperty("adaptiveMapResolution");
                            resolution.intValue = EditorGUILayout.IntPopup(new GUIContent("Map Resolution", "32 to 512. Higher resolution captures smaller surface details and uses more memory. Separate from baked Landing Accuracy. Refresh Surface after changing the ground."),
                                Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.ClosestPowerOfTwo(resolution.intValue),32,512), new[]{new GUIContent("32"), new GUIContent("64"), new GUIContent("128"), new GUIContent("256"), new GUIContent("512")}, new[]{32,64,128,256,512});
                            if (GUILayout.Button("Refresh Surface"))
                            {
                                serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();
                                playback.RefreshAdaptiveSurface();
                            }
                        }
                        EditorGUILayout.LabelField("World Y · anchored pieces stay fixed · rigid chunks", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Muted);
                    }
                }
                if (playback.HasCollisionPlayback)
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(playback.collisionData.BodyCount +
                        " recorded collision bodies · fixed physics clock.", MessageType.None);
                bool effectsChanged = DrawPlaybackEffects(playback);
                DrawDebrisSettings(playback);
                DrawFooter(playback);
                if (serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties())
                {
                    if (effectsChanged) playback.RefreshPlaybackEffects();
                    playback.ApplyRendererBounds();
                    // Refresh already restores the particle tail after Body playback ends.
                    if (!effectsChanged)
                        playback.ApplyFrame(playback.useManualFrame ? playback.manualFrame : playback.CurrentFrame);
                    SceneView.RepaintAll();
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth = oldLabelWidth;
                EditorGUI.indentLevel = oldIndent;
            }
        }

        private static Rect Row(float height = 20)
        {
            return EditorGUILayout.GetControlRect(false, height);
        }

        private static void DrawHeader(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback)
        {
            Rect header = Row(52);
            Rect logo = new Rect(header.x, header.y + 5, 42, 40);
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(logo, new Color(.12f, .14f, .15f));
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(logo.x, logo.y, logo.width, 2), RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Accent);
            GUI.Label(logo, "RVFX", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Logo);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(header.x + 52, header.y + 6, header.width - 52, 21),
                "GPU PLAYBACK", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Title);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(header.x + 52, header.y + 28, header.width - 52, 18),
                new GUIContent(playback.gameObject.name, playback.gameObject.name), RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Muted);
            using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Card))
            {
                Rect stats = Row(18);
                string[] values =
                {
                    Mathf.Max(0, playback.pieceCount).ToString("N0") + " Pieces",
                    playback.GetSecondaryDebrisBakedPointCount().ToString("N0") + " Debris",
                    (Mathf.Max(0, playback.frameCount - 1) / Mathf.Max(1, playback.fps)).ToString("0.00") + " s",
                    playback.fps.ToString("0.#") + " FPS"
                };
                float width = stats.width / 4;
                var centered = RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.ButtonLabel;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
                {
                    GUI.Label(new Rect(stats.x + i * width, stats.y, width, stats.height), values[i], centered);
                    if (i > 0) EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(stats.x + i * width, stats.y + 3, 1, 12),
                        new Color(.5f, .5f, .5f, .25f));
                }
            }
        }

        private void DrawPreview(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback)
        {
            using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Card))
            {
                bool running = playback.IsPreviewRunning;
                Rect heading = Row();
                GUI.Label(heading, "PREVIEW", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Section);
                string state = !playback.isActiveAndEnabled ? "Inactive" :
                    EditorApplication.isPlaying && EditorApplication.isPaused ? "Editor paused" :
                    playback.IsWaitingForDelay ? "Waiting" : running ? "Playing" : "Paused";
                GUI.Label(heading, state, RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Right);
                int maxFrame = Mathf.Max(0, playback.frameCount - 1);
                float frame = playback.PreviewTimelineFrame;
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!playback.isActiveAndEnabled))
                {
                    Rect transport = Row(28);
                    float small = Mathf.Clamp(transport.width * .14f, 26, 48);
                    float playWidth = transport.width - (small + 4) * 4;
                    Rect button = new Rect(transport.x, transport.y, small, transport.height);
                    if (RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.IconButton(button, RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Icon.First, "", "First frame"))
                        Seek(playback, 0);
                    button.x += small + 4;
                    if (RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.IconButton(button, RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Icon.Previous, "", "Previous frame"))
                        Seek(playback, Mathf.Ceil(frame) - 1);
                    button.x += small + 4;
                    button.width = playWidth;
                    if (RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.IconButton(button, running ? RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Icon.Pause :
                            RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Icon.Play, running ? "Pause" : "Play",
                            running ? "Pause at the current time" : "Continue from the playhead", true))
                        Command(playback, running ? (System.Action)(() => playback.Pause()) : () => playback.Play(), "Playback transport");
                    button.x += playWidth + 4;
                    button.width = small;
                    if (RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.IconButton(button, RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Icon.Next, "", "Next frame"))
                        Seek(playback, Mathf.Floor(frame) + 1);
                    button.x += small + 4;
                    if (RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.IconButton(button, RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Icon.Last, "", "Last frame"))
                        Seek(playback, maxFrame);

                    GUILayout.Space(4);
                    Rect slider = Row(22);
                    EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(slider.x + 4, slider.y + 7, slider.width - 8, 4),
                        new Color(.11f, .12f, .13f));
                    EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(slider.x + 4, slider.y + 7,
                        (slider.width - 8) * (maxFrame > 0 ? frame / maxFrame : 0), 4),
                        RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Accent);
                    EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
                    float seekFrame = GUI.HorizontalSlider(new Rect(slider.x + 1, slider.y + 2, slider.width - 2, 18),
                        frame, 0, maxFrame, RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Slider, RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Thumb);
                    if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()) Seek(playback, seekFrame);
                    if (Event.current.type == EventType.Repaint)
                        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++)
                            EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(slider.x + 4 + (slider.width - 8) * i / 20,
                                slider.y + 18, 1, i % 5 == 0 ? 4 : 2), new Color(.5f, .6f, .65f, .35f));

                    Rect time = Row();
                    float fps = Mathf.Max(1, playback.fps);
                    GUI.Label(new Rect(time.x, time.y, time.width - 150, time.height),
                        (frame / fps).ToString("0.00") + " / " + (maxFrame / fps).ToString("0.00") + " s",
                        RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Muted);
                    Rect field = new Rect(time.xMax - 150, time.y, 106, time.height);
                    float width = EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth;
                    EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth = 43;
                    EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
                    int entered = EditorGUI.DelayedIntField(field, new GUIContent("Frame",
                        "Timeline frame before Time Remap. Editing pauses playback."), Mathf.RoundToInt(frame));
                    if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()) Seek(playback, entered);
                    EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth = width;
                    GUI.Label(new Rect(time.xMax - 40, time.y, 40, time.height), "/ " + maxFrame,
                        RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Right);
                }
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Drag to seek. Play resumes from here.", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Muted);
            }
        }

        private void Seek(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback, float frame)
        {
            Command(playback, () => playback.SeekPreviewFrame(Mathf.Round(frame)), "Seek GPU playback");
        }

        private void Command(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback, System.Action action, string undoLabel)
        {
            serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();
            Undo.RecordObject(playback, undoLabel);
            action();
            PrefabUtility.RecordPrefabInstancePropertyModifications(playback);
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(playback);
            serializedObject.Update();
            SceneView.RepaintAll();
            EditorApplication.QueuePlayerLoopUpdate();
            Repaint();
        }

        private void DrawSettings()
        {
            using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Card))
            {
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("PLAYBACK SETTINGS", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Section);
                Rect toggles = Row();
                float half = (toggles.width - 12) * .5f;
                Toggle(new Rect(toggles.x, toggles.y, half, 20), "playOnAwake", "Play On Awake",
                    "Automatically starts when the object becomes active. Turn off for code-triggered playback.");
                Toggle(new Rect(toggles.x + half + 12, toggles.y, half, 20), "loop", "Loop",
                    "Repeat after the last frame.");
                Rect values = Row();
                LabeledProperty(new Rect(values.x, values.y, half, 20), "startDelay", "Delay (s)", 62);
                LabeledProperty(new Rect(values.x + half + 12, values.y, half, 20), "playbackSpeed", "Speed", 42);
                Rect remap = Row();
                _showRemap = EditorGUI.Foldout(new Rect(remap.x + 10, remap.y, remap.width - 10, 20),
                    _showRemap, new GUIContent("Time Remap", "X: elapsed time. Y: sampled baked time."), true);
                if (_showRemap)
                    EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("playbackCurve"), GUIContent.none,
                        GUILayout.Height(40));
            }
        }

        private void DrawDebrisSettings(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback)
        {
            if (playback.secondaryDebrisBinaryData == null || playback.GetSecondaryDebrisBakedPointCount() <= 0)
                return;
            using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Card))
            {
                Rect heading = Row();
                GUI.Label(heading, "DEBRIS", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Section);
                Toggle(new Rect(heading.xMax - 70, heading.y, 70, 20), "secondaryDebrisDrawEnabled", "Enabled",
                    "Render the baked GPU-instanced debris.");
                bool enabled = serializedObject.FindProperty("secondaryDebrisDrawEnabled").boolValue;
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!enabled))
                {
                    DrawDebrisMeshPairs();
                    EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("cpuFallbackDebrisLimit"),
                        new GUIContent("Fallback Limit", "Maximum debris points when GPU playback falls back to CPU. Supported GPU playback keeps all points."));
                    GUILayout.Space(4);
                    Rect visibility = Row();
                    GUI.Label(new Rect(visibility.x, visibility.y, 66, 20), "Visibility");
                    float remaining = (visibility.width - 70) * .5f;
                    Toggle(new Rect(visibility.x + 70, visibility.y, remaining, 20),
                        "secondaryDebrisShowInSceneView", "Scene", "Draw debris in Scene View.");
                    Toggle(new Rect(visibility.x + 70 + remaining, visibility.y, remaining, 20),
                        "secondaryDebrisShowInGameView", "Game", "Draw debris in Game View and runtime cameras.");
                    Rect shadows = Row();
                    GUI.Label(new Rect(shadows.x, shadows.y, 66, 20), "Shadows");
                    LabeledProperty(new Rect(shadows.x + 70, shadows.y, remaining - 7, 20),
                        "secondaryDebrisShadowCastingMode", "Cast", 30);
                    Toggle(new Rect(shadows.x + 70 + remaining, shadows.y, remaining, 20),
                        "secondaryDebrisReceiveShadows", "Receive", "Receive scene shadows.");
                }
                if (!enabled)
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Disabled · debris data and GPU buffers stay unloaded.", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Muted);
                else if (!serializedObject.FindProperty("secondaryDebrisShowInSceneView").boolValue &&
                         !serializedObject.FindProperty("secondaryDebrisShowInGameView").boolValue)
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("No view enabled · debris stays unloaded.", MessageType.None);
            }
        }

        private void DrawDebrisMeshPairs()
        {
            var entries = serializedObject.FindProperty("secondaryDebrisMeshEntries");
            if (entries == null || entries.arraySize == 0)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serializedObject.FindProperty("secondaryDebrisMaterial"),
                    new GUIContent("Material"));
                return;
            }
            Rect title = Row(17);
            GUI.Label(title, "MESH", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Muted);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(title.x + (title.width + 6) * .5f, title.y, title.width * .5f - 3, title.height),
                "MATERIAL", RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Muted);
            for (int i = 0; i < entries.arraySize; i++)
            {
                var entry = entries.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i);
                var mesh = entry.FindPropertyRelative("mesh");
                var material = entry.FindPropertyRelative("material");
                Rect row = Row(25);
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(row, new Color(0, 0, 0, i % 2 == 0 ? .12f : .05f));
                float width = (row.width - 6) * .5f;
                EditorGUI.PropertyField(new Rect(row.x, row.y + 3, width, 19),
                    mesh, new GUIContent("", "Replace this slot's visual mesh. Recorded motion stays unchanged. None uses a fallback box."));
                EditorGUI.PropertyField(new Rect(row.x + width + 6, row.y + 3, width, 19),
                    material, GUIContent.none);
            }
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Replace mesh and material. Baked motion stays unchanged.", EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
            if (EditorApplication.isPlaying)
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Play Mode edits are temporary. Edit outside Play Mode to save them.", MessageType.Info);
        }

        private void Toggle(Rect rect, string propertyName, string label, string tooltip)
        {
            var property = serializedObject.FindProperty(propertyName);
            EditorGUI.BeginProperty(rect, new GUIContent(label, tooltip), property);
            property.boolValue = EditorGUI.ToggleLeft(rect, new GUIContent(label, tooltip), property.boolValue);
            EditorGUI.EndProperty();
        }

        private void LabeledProperty(Rect rect, string propertyName, string label, float labelWidth)
        {
            float previous = EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth;
            EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth = labelWidth;
            EditorGUI.PropertyField(rect, serializedObject.FindProperty(propertyName), new GUIContent(label));
            EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth = previous;
        }

        private void DrawFooter(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback)
        {
            GUILayout.Space(4);
            Rect footer = Row(25);
            _showCodeExample = EditorGUI.Foldout(new Rect(footer.x + 10, footer.y, footer.width - 145, 22),
                _showCodeExample, "Code Example", true);
            using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!playback.isActiveAndEnabled))
                if (RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.IconButton(new Rect(footer.xMax - 126, footer.y, 126, 23),
                        RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Icon.Reset, "Reset to Start", "Rewind and pause at frame zero"))
                    Command(playback, () => playback.Stop(), "Reset GPU playback");
            if (!_showCodeExample) return;
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Turn Play On Awake off for code-triggered playback. Pause holds Base and Debris together.",
                MessageType.None);
            var style = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.textArea) { wordWrap = true, fontSize = 11 };
            EditorGUILayout.SelectableLabel(PlaybackCodeExample, style,
                GUILayout.Height(style.CalcHeight(new GUIContent(PlaybackCodeExample),
                    Mathf.Max(200, EditorGUIUtility.currentViewWidth - 40))));
            if (GUILayout.Button("Copy Code", EditorStyles.miniButton)) EditorGUIUtility.systemCopyBuffer = PlaybackCodeExample;
        }
    }
}
#endif
